Write the output of cv_scenarios() to disk

Source: R/export_scenarios.R
export_scenarios.Rd

Writes <path>/<dir>/param_est_data/... and <path>/<dir>/cv_data/... for every scenario with export_nest(), e.g. cv_data/adg/nls/Repeat01/Fold1/train.txt.

export_scenarios(
  x,
  path = tempdir(),
  dirs = NULL,
  na = ".",
  file_type = "txt",
  quote = FALSE,
  ...
)

Arguments

x

Output of cv_scenarios().

path

Root folder.

dirs

Optional named character vector of folder names per scenario, e.g. c(st_sp = "2.1.st_sp"); scenario names are used otherwise.

na

Missing-value code written to the files (default ".").

file_type

Either "txt" (tab-separated, default) or "csv" (comma-separated). Case-insensitive.

quote

Passed to fwrite. Default FALSE: with a non-empty na, fwrite's "auto" would quote every header and character field, which command-line breeding programs (HIBLUP, DMU, ...) cannot parse. Use "auto" if values may contain the separator.

...

Further arguments passed to fwrite (e.g. col.names = FALSE for software that expects no header).

Value

The written file paths, invisibly.

Examples

dat <- data.frame(id = paste0("i", 1:40), herd = rep(c("A", "B"), each = 20),
                  adg = rnorm(40), bf = rnorm(40))
sc <- cv_scenarios(dat, cols = c("adg", "bf"), id = "id", group = "herd",
                   v = 2, seed = 1, scenarios = c("st_sp", "mt_bt"))
files <- export_scenarios(sc, path = file.path(tempdir(), "gblup"))
head(files)
#> [1] "/tmp/RtmpfnJdH6/gblup/st_sp/param_est_data/adg/A/data.txt"           
#> [2] "/tmp/RtmpfnJdH6/gblup/st_sp/param_est_data/adg/B/data.txt"           
#> [3] "/tmp/RtmpfnJdH6/gblup/st_sp/param_est_data/bf/A/data.txt"            
#> [4] "/tmp/RtmpfnJdH6/gblup/st_sp/param_est_data/bf/B/data.txt"            
#> [5] "/tmp/RtmpfnJdH6/gblup/st_sp/cv_data/adg/A/Repeat1/Fold1/train.txt"   
#> [6] "/tmp/RtmpfnJdH6/gblup/st_sp/cv_data/adg/A/Repeat1/Fold1/validate.txt"
